data.gender_notes: Appa is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Appa is a Sanskrit word that means 'father'. In Hindu mythology, Appa is also the name of a god associated with creation, protection, and nurturing. The term 'Appa' is used with deep reverence and love towards a father figure, symbolizing strength, wisdom, and care. The name Appa carries the meaning “Father” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Appa usually hope their child will grow to embody father and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of unconditional love, protection, and nurturing.
data.etymology: Appa belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Father.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Appa total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: In Indian culture, Appa is used as a term of respect and love towards a father figure, carrying the deepest sense of affection and honor. In many Hindu families, the father holds an esteemed position as the primary provider, protector, and teacher.
data.spiritual_significance: Appa carries immense spiritual significance, representing the divine father figure in Hindu mythology. As per Hindu scriptures, Lord Shiva is referred to as Appa, the father of the universe, in the Ardhanarishvara form (Lord Shiva with his wife Shakti.) This name Appa signifies the creation, protection, and nurturing aspects of the divine. Honoring one's father by referring to him as Appa reaffirms the profound respect and acknowledgment of the Divine Father, and the bond between the father and child is considered a reflection of this divine connection.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Appa in Hinduism is a term of deep reverence and love, symbolizing the role of a father. It embodies the unwavering support, strength, and wisdom of a father figure, making it a treasured name for children.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that The name Appa is mentioned in the Tirukkural, a 2nd-century BCE Tamil text. The name Appa carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Appa is used to refer to a father or a guardian in the Tirukkural.
